clause_audits.response_span: The recorded navigation action reported succeeded.

The visible configuration records the rotational stopped-velocity tolerance; this configuration observation does not establish internal consumption, physical stopping, or a stopping cause (rot stopped velocity: 0.05 rad/s).

The visible configuration records the translational stopped-velocity tolerance; this configuration observation does not establish internal consumption, physical stopping, or a stopping cause (trans stopped velocity: 0.05 m/s).
The visible configuration records the XY goal tolerance; this configuration observation does not establish internal consumption, physical stopping, or a stopping cause (xy goal tolerance: 0.4 m).

The visible configuration records the yaw goal tolerance; this configuration observation does not establish internal consumption, physical stopping, or a stopping cause (yaw goal tolerance: 0.35 rad).
The task requires no prohibited hull contact during the dwell; available contact evidence does not establish whether this requirement held.
The declared dwell starts at the first post-result observation, independently of action receipt time (interval end: 71.75114465 s; interval start: 66.75114465 s).
An observed violation establishes failure of the specified fixed docking dwell.
The explanation uses only the declared robot-visible packet; delivered observations do not prove Nav2 internal consumption.
The heading requirement holds at all retained dwell samples under the declared uncertainty contract; full sampled-window coverage is available (maximum gap: 0.019999993 s; sample count: 251 samples).
The hull requirement holds at all retained dwell samples under the declared uncertainty contract; full sampled-window coverage is available (maximum gap: 0.019999993 s; sample count: 251 samples).

An observed position violation falsifies the corresponding dwell requirement. Values are measured at the witness sample, not an inferred continuous-time crossing (measured value: 0.400514350256 m; requirement bound: 0.4 m; signed margin: -0.000514350256428 m; witness time: 69.191143785 s).

The separate public docking task requires the fixed dwell and position, heading, speed, and yaw-rate limits shown here; configured navigation tolerances do not replace these requirements (dwell s: 5 s; heading tolerance rad: 0.35 rad; position tolerance m: 0.4 m; speed tolerance mps: 0.05 m/s; yaw rate tolerance radps: 0.05 rad/s).
The signed change in observed radial position error from the declared reference observation to the final selected dwell sample is as follows (radial error change: 0.146664863277 m).

The recorded client receipt time uses the fixture-monotonic wall clock; it is not the ROS-header sample clock or the first post-result sample that anchors the fixed dwell (receipt wall seconds: 65.167916154 s).
The declared delivered reference observation has the following measured heading error (heading bound: 0.35 rad; heading error: 0.0967294318143 rad).

The declared delivered reference observation has the following measured position error and signed position margin (observation time: 66.731144657 s; position bound: 0.4 m; position error: 0.331505189056 m; position margin: 0.068494810944 m).
The declared delivered reference observation has the following measured translational speed (measured speed: 0.047083208187 m/s; speed bound: 0.05 m/s).
The speed requirement holds at all retained dwell samples under the declared uncertainty contract; full sampled-window coverage is available (maximum gap: 0.019999993 s; sample count: 251 samples).

The yaw rate requirement holds at all retained dwell samples under the declared uncertainty contract; full sampled-window coverage is available (maximum gap: 0.019999993 s; sample count: 251 samples).
These observations do not identify a unique physical cause; waves, current, wind and actuation remain unresolved.
Samples do not establish continuous-time compliance between observations; an observed violation is sufficient to falsify the dwell.
